UNITED STATES COAST GUARD

COMMANDER (oan)

Ninth Coast Guard District
1240 East 9th St.

Cleveland, Ohio 44199

5922 Ser B-207 14 April 1972
National Director Bureau of Sport Fisheries & Wildlife Department of the Interior Washington, D. C. 20240

Sincerely,
R. W. GASIOR
